Services

Physiotherapy for a Healthier, Stronger You

From pain management and orthopaedic care to rehabilitation after surgery and support at home, we help people of all ages move with greater comfort and confidence.

01 / PAIN MANAGEMENT

Move with less pain.

Physiotherapy for back, neck, shoulder, knee, joint and other musculoskeletal pain.

02 / SPORTS REHABILITATION

Recover. Rebuild. Return.

Progressive rehabilitation for sports injuries, strength, movement control and return to activity.

03 / FUNCTIONAL DEVELOPMENT

Build useful strength.

Improve strength, mobility, balance, coordination and confidence for everyday function and sport.

04 / ORTHOPAEDIC PHYSIOTHERAPY

Restore movement.

Individualised rehabilitation for musculoskeletal conditions and movement limitations.

05 / POST-SURGICAL REHABILITATION

Progress step by step.

Structured recovery following orthopaedic procedures, guided by your stage and goals.

06 / NEUROLOGICAL REHABILITATION

Improve function.

Goal-oriented rehabilitation for mobility, balance, coordination and independence.

07 / PAEDIATRIC PHYSIOTHERAPY

Support growing movement.

Age-appropriate support for children's movement, coordination, development and function.

08 / GERIATRIC PHYSIOTHERAPY

Move with confidence.

Strength, balance, mobility and fall-prevention support for older adults.

09 / WOMEN'S HEALTH

Care through life stages.

Individualised pre- and postnatal support and pelvic-health rehabilitation where appropriate.

10 / RESPIRATORY PHYSIOTHERAPY

Breathe and move easier.

Breathing exercises and respiratory rehabilitation tailored to clinical needs.

11 / HOME CARE PHYSIOTHERAPY

Care at your doorstep.

Physiotherapy support at home for people who need a convenient care option.

12 / POSTURE & ERGONOMICS

Move well at work.

Practical guidance for posture, workstation habits and movement breaks during daily activities.
